description: TRI: Search Toxic Release Inventory data across facilities in a state or county, for one reporting year or, without year, every available year newest first. Returns facility name and county, TRI facility ID, EPA Registry ID (the registry_id epa_echo_get_facility takes), parent company, chemical name, and the Form R one-time release quantity; set include_release_breakdown to add on-site releases by medium (air, water, land, and underground-injection) and their total, at the cost of a slower call. Quantities are in pounds; dioxin and dioxin-like compounds, which TRI has facilities report in grams, are converted and marked with reportedUnit. Records come in reporting-year order, not ranked by quantity; page through a large match with offset and nextOffset. Use to build an environmental exposure profile for an area. Use epa_tri_get_facility_releases for detailed release records for a single facility. TRI data lags ~18 months from the current calendar year.

chemical_name.description: Optional filter to restrict results to a specific chemical (partial match, case-insensitive). Commas, apostrophes, brackets, and Greek letters are matched as written, e.g. "4,4'-Methylenedianiline".

county.description: County name to narrow results within the state, e.g. "King". Case-insensitive partial match on the bare name, so a short name can also match a longer one (LAKE matches LAKE OF THE WOODS; check countyName on each record); a trailing "County", "Parish", "Borough", "City and Borough", "Census Area", or "Municipality" is dropped before matching. Punctuation is matched as written ("Prince George's").

include_release_breakdown.description: Add on-site releases by medium (air, water, land, underground injection) and their total to each record. Costs one extra upstream request, which can add about 20 seconds when EPA has not cached it.

limit.description: Maximum number of release records to return in one call (1–200, default 50). A larger value, up to 5,000, returns 200 with a notice. Page past it with offset and nextOffset.

offset.description: Number of release records to skip before this page (default 0). Pass the previous call's nextOffset to continue; a value past the end returns an empty page.

state.description: 2-letter US state or territory code (required, e.g. "WA", "TX", "PR")

year.description: Reporting year. Omit to search every available year in the state, newest reporting year first, so the first page holds the most recent filings. TRI data lags ~18 months.

name: epa_tri_search_releases

cap.description: The limit that was applied. Present only when truncated.

effectiveQuery.description: The search as the server sent it upstream, in this tool's input names: normalized values, how each text filter matched ("=" exact, "contains", "begins with", "has words"), and defaults that change what comes back. Terms are separated by "; ".

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_state`: state has the 2-character form but is not a US state, DC, territory, freely associated state, UM, NN, or EPA region code. `unmatchable_filter`: county or chemical_name has no letter or digit for EPA's DMAP service to match on. `filter_too_long`: county and chemical_name make a request longer than EPA's DMAP service accepts. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: Present when truncated: the offset that continues the search.

limitNotice.description: Present when limit was above the cap and the call returned the cap instead.

message.description: Recovery hint when no releases are found. Absent when releases are returned.

nextOffset.description: Offset of the next page: present exactly when more records follow, absent on the last page. Pass it as offset to continue.

notice.description: Present when a punctuated county or chemical_name filter read its page limit before finding limit matches spelled as given, so more matching records may exist.

releases.description: TRI release records for facilities in the queried state and filters

items.description: TRI release record for a facility-chemical-year combination

chemicalName.description: Chemical name as reported to TRI

countyName.description: County as TRI records the facility's location (e.g. "KING", "CALCASIEU PARISH"). The county filter is a partial match, so a short name can also match a longer one (LAKE matches LAKE OF THE WOODS); check this field to keep only the county you meant.

oneTimeReleaseInLbs.description: Form R Section 8.8 one-time release quantity in pounds (remedial actions, catastrophic events, and other one-time events not associated with production). It is already counted in the per-medium releases and the off-site transfers, so it is never added to them.

parentCompany.description: Parent company as TRI standardizes its name. Absent when TRI records no parent company (its placeholder is NA).

registryId.description: 12-digit EPA Facility Registry Service ID; pass it as registry_id to epa_echo_get_facility for the facility's compliance profile. Absent when TRI records none.

releasesToAirInLbs.description: On-site air releases (fugitive + stack emissions) in pounds, summed across air release types for this submission. Only with include_release_breakdown.

releasesToLandInLbs.description: On-site land releases in pounds — landfills, land treatment, surface impoundment, and other on-site disposal, summed for this submission. Only with include_release_breakdown.

releasesToUndergroundInjectionInLbs.description: On-site releases via underground injection wells in pounds, summed across injection well classes for this submission. Only with include_release_breakdown.

releasesToWaterInLbs.description: On-site releases to surface water in pounds, summed across all reported outfalls for this submission. Only with include_release_breakdown.

reportedUnit.description: Present as "grams" when TRI had the facility report this chemical in grams (dioxin and dioxin-like compounds); its quantities here are converted to pounds (1 lb = 453.59237 g). Absent for chemicals reported in pounds.

totalOnSiteReleasesInLbs.description: Sum of the per-medium on-site releases present on this record (Form R Sections 5.1–5.5.4), in pounds. A medium TRI recorded only as a range code is left out, as it is from the per-medium fields; TRI's published on-site total counts a range at its midpoint, so it can be higher. Only with include_release_breakdown, and absent when no medium has a quantity.

shown.description: Number of release records returned. Present only when truncated.

state.description: State queried, as the search sent it (uppercase code)

truncated.description: True when more release records may follow this page; nextOffset continues it. Absent on the last page.

title: Search TRI Releases by Region
